l.i: Hortor omnes qui se aut sacris aut profanis studiis dediderunt adolescentes, ut Severum hunc eo animo legant, ut plurimum se non tam imprudentia, quam in religionis & innocentia studio profecturos esse confidant. Addo etiam latina eloquentia[?], quam ille tanta industria coluit, ut Sallustianam dictionem nobis magna ex parte expresserit.

page.notes: The faint large letters above the heading (readable as "SVLPICII") are show-through from the reverse side and are not transcribed. In the first line "studiis" is broken at the line end as "stu-diis", and the printed hyphen is kept. "eloquentia" is doubtful: the scan at this word is worn, so the reading is marked [?]. The long s is written as a plain s throughout, and the printed spelling "innocentia" and "latina" is kept.
